This credit comprises both working capital and investment loans aimed at enhancing business capacity, subject to specific credit ceilings: micro up to Rp50 million, small >Rp50 million–Rp500 million, and medium >Rp500 million–Rp5 billion.

Source: Bank Indonesia (BI)
descriptionId:

Rp50 juta, kecil >Rp50 juta-Rp500 juta, dan menengah >Rp500 juta-Rp5 miliar.

title: Total Residential Property Price Index (IHPR)
titleId: Indeks Harga Properti Residensial (IHPR) Total
description:
The Residential Property Price Index (IHPR) is the result of the Residential Property Price Survey (SHPR), a quarterly survey conducted among a sample of residential property developers in 16 cities: Jabodebek and Banten, Bandung, Surabaya, Semarang, Yogyakarta, Manado, Makassar, Denpasar, Pontianak, Banjarmasin, Bandar Lampung, Palembang, Padang, Medan, Batam, and Balikpapan. In the first quarter of 2018, two additional cities were included, Pekanbaru and Samarinda, bringing the total coverage to 18 cities. Data collection is performed through direct, face to face interviews. 

Source: Bank Indonesia (BI)
descriptionId:

Bandung, Surabaya, Semarang, Yogyakarta, Manado, Makasar, Denpasar, Pontianak,

pelaksanaan SHPR triwulan I 2018 terdapat tambahan 2 kota yaitu kota Pekanbaru dan
Samarinda sehingga total cakupan kota pelaksana SHPR menjadi 18 kota. Pengumpulan data dilakukan secara langsung ( face to face).

title: Monthly Growth of Real Sales Index Based on Goods Group
description:
The Real Sales Index (IPR) is derived from the Retail Sales Survey (SPE), which involves 700 selected retailers (purposive sampling) across 10 cities: Jakarta, Semarang, Bandung, Surabaya, Medan, Purwokerto, Makassar, Manado, Banjarmasin, and Denpasar. The Real Sales Index (IPR) is calculated using commodity weights from the Input-Output table and city weights based on the share of household consumption in the Regional Gross Domestic Product (RGDP), using 2010=100 as the base year.

Source: Bank Indonesia (BI)
chartTitle: Monthly growth of Real Sales Index Based on Goods Group

This credit comprises both working capital and investment loans aimed at enhancing business capacity, subject to specific credit ceilings: micro up to Rp50 million, small >Rp50 million–Rp500 million, and medium >Rp500 million–Rp5 billion.
Source: Bank Indonesia (BI)
